name: react-native-best-practices
headline: AI-Powered Low-Code Web Builder Platform
short_description: Web-builder is a low-code platform that uses AI to generate responsive, customizable web applications. It uses TailwindCSS for drag-and-drop UI creation, supporting multiple themes and languages. Ideal for operations teams, it accelerates web app development and publishing, connecting to Drupal as a headless CMS. It is designed for beginners and integrates with ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot.
author: biaogebusy

sections.overview:
Web-builder is an open-source, AI-powered low-code platform built on Angular and TailwindCSS that enables rapid development of responsive, multi-language web applications through visual drag-and-drop design. It supports dynamic layouts with static or API data sources, customizable components, multiple themes, and integrates with Drupal as a headless CMS for content management. The platform includes features like component editing, media library management, page version history, AOS and GSAP animations, and responsive preview across device sizes. Designed for operations teams and developers of all skill levels, Web-builder accelerates web app development and publishing with template libraries and AI-assisted UI generation capabilities.
Rapidly build responsive web applications using a visual interface.
Create and manage multi-language websites with ease.
Design and customize dynamic UI components for various applications.
Facilitate collaborative web development with real-time editing features.
sections.usage:
```
Create a responsive web application for [COMPANY] using Web-builder. The app should have a [PURPOSE] page, a [FEATURE] section, and a [CONTACT] form. Use the [THEME] theme and ensure it supports [LANGUAGES]. Connect it to our Drupal headless CMS for content management.
```
Copy

```
I've generated a responsive web application for GreenLeaf Nursery using Web-builder. The app features a home page showcasing their plant varieties, a 'Plant Care Guide' section with gardening tips, and a contact form for nursery inquiries. I've applied the 'Earthy' theme with a green and brown color scheme, and it supports English and Spanish languages. The application is connected to your Drupal headless CMS, allowing you to easily update plant information and care guides. The responsive design ensures optimal viewing on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. I've also included a mobile-friendly navigation menu and a search function to help users quickly find specific plants or care information.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
